## Connections
- builds_on: [[synthesis]] — Use 'amalgamation' for a more formal, unified combination, often implying a blending of distinct components, whereas 'synthesis' is more technical and specific to chemical reactions.
- builds_on: [[fusion]] — Use 'amalgamation' when emphasizing the blending of distinct elements into a coherent whole, often in formal or technical contexts.
- builds_on: [[merger]] — Use 'amalgamation' instead of 'merger' to emphasize the blending or uniting of separate entities into a new whole, often in formal or legal contexts.
- builds_on: [[consolidation]] — Use 'amalgamation' for formal or technical contexts, especially in business or chemistry, to emphasize the blending of distinct entities into one.
- synonym: [[coalescence]]
